title: BetterShearing
description: Client side hitbox fix for sheep shearing
body:
Shearing sheep in Minecraft can be incredibly frustrating, especially when they are crammed together in a pen and overlapping hitboxes prevent you from targeting the right god dawm sheep. 

This simple **client-side** QoL mod fixes this issue by introducing smart target selection. 

* **Smart Targeting:** Intelligently checks your line of sight to prioritize sheep that actually have wool.
* **Ignores Sheared Sheep:** Will completely bypass already sheared sheep, meaning no more spam clicking in crowded pens.
* **Client-Side Only:** Because this mod is 100% client-side, you can use it safely on vanilla multiplayer servers and Realms without the server needing the mod installed
